facts.text: The image is a multi-panel creature design reference sheet for a single dragon, laid out on a black background with thin grey dividers.
The top panel spans the full width and shows the dragon in a dark volcanic landscape with rocky crags, wet reflective black ground, and faint orange lava glow in the background haze.
In the top panel the dragon stands on four legs with its wings partly raised and spread to the right, its long horned head lowered toward the ground; the pose is static.

The dragon has dark charcoal-to-black armor-like scales with cool blue and teal iridescent highlights, a row of long spikes running from the neck along the back and tail, and several large pale bone-colored horns swept back from the skull.

The middle row contains three full-body panels labeled in white capital letters: "FRONT" (left, dragon facing the viewer with wings spread symmetrically), "SIDE PROFILE" (center, dragon in profile with long tail extended to the right), and "REAR" (right, dragon seen from behind with wings spread).

The bottom row contains four detail panels labeled in white capital letters: "HEAD CLOSE" (extreme close-up of the horned head with a small amber eye visible), "WING MEMBRANE" (close view of the thin, veined dark wing skin and finger struts), "CLAW AND FOOT" (close view of scaled toes ending in curved pale talons), and "SCALE DETAIL" (close view of overlapping ridged dark blue-black scales).
The full-body turnaround panels use a plain dark gradient backdrop with soft top-down studio-like lighting, unlike the environmental top panel.
Overall rendering style is highly detailed, dark fantasy photorealistic creature concept art with strong specular highlights on the wet scales and horns.
Visible text in the sheet is limited to the panel captions: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, SCALE DETAIL.

card.summary: A dark fantasy creature reference sheet for a single black-scaled dragon, combining one large atmospheric scene at the top with a front/side/rear turnaround row and four close-up detail panels (head, wing membrane, claw and foot, scale texture).

subjects.descriptor: Large winged dragon with dark iridescent scales and long swept-back horns
attributes: charcoal-black to blue-black armored scales with teal and blue iridescence
several long pale bone-colored horns swept back from the skull
row of tall spikes along neck, spine and tail
large membranous wings with thin veined skin and dark finger struts
four legs with scaled feet and curved pale talons
pose: top panel: standing on all fours, head lowered, wings partly raised
FRONT panel: facing viewer, wings spread symmetrically
SIDE PROFILE panel: standing in profile, tail extended
REAR panel: viewed from behind, wings spread
detail panels: head, wing, foot and scales shown close-up

card.environment: Top panel: dark volcanic terrain with jagged rock formations, wet reflective black ground and distant orange lava glow under heavy dark haze; remaining panels: plain dark gradient studio backdrop.
card.lighting: Moody low-key lighting overall; top panel lit by dim diffuse sky light with warm orange lava glow from the background, turnaround and detail panels lit by soft top-down studio-style light with specular highlights on scales and horns.
card.framing: Single wide landscape sheet divided into panels: a full-width scene at top, a row of three equal full-body views, and a row of four equal close-up crops.
card.style: Dark fantasy photorealistic creature concept art / character design reference sheet
card.characterisation: Menacing, ancient, armored dragon design emphasizing heavy scales, horns and spikes.

limitations: No motion, sound, or sequence can be inferred from this static sheet.
The dragon's exact size relative to real-world scale is not indicated.
Detail panels are close crops and do not show the whole body.
